new_value.evidence_summary: River stores its oracle address in a mutable unstructured-storage slot through OracleAddress.get()/set(). Repository search found no post-initialization admin-callable setOracle(), and initRiverV1() sets the address once. However, River is a TUPProxy: the 4-of-7 Proxy Admin Safe, with no timelock, can upgrade the implementation and reach OracleAddress.set(). The address is therefore technically replaceable through an upgrade, rather than EVM-immutable; absence of a direct setter means replacement requires a full upgrade. Yellow reflects that higher-overhead but still material governance path.
new_value.notes: GitHub issue #66 factual-correction update. Evidence-only or narrowed partial acceptance; score retained.
